record.label: Finite-rank AQ cannot exactly seed a full Gaussian width
record.summary: For an AQ scalar, kappa4=48(tr A^4+u^T A^2u) is nonnegative and vanishes only when A=0; exact joint Gaussianity therefore leaves covariance rank at most r.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for raw-Gaussian initialization at r below width; begin after a nonlinear prefix or charge the large non-Gaussian seed defect.
